title: Glymphatic system evaluation via magnetic resonance imaging in patients with cerebrovascular small vessel disease (CVSD)
summary:
The glymphatic system is a new term for cerebrospinal and interstitial fluid exchange processes in the brain. It has been shown that impaired function of this system is involved in pathological and inflammatory processes in the brain. Therefore, studying the glymphatic system function using non-invasive techniques is essential in the clinical environment as a new biomarker.
Diffusion tensor imaging along perivascular spaces (DTI-ALPS) is a new method to assess the function of the glymphatic system non-invasively. DTI-ALPS showed its applicability in the brain in neurodegenerative diseases and inflammatory processes, providing an index that is believed to be related to the function of the glymphatic system. In this study, we plan to analyze the DTI-ALPS index in patients with cerebrovascular small vessel disease.

interventions.name: Acquisition of DTI-ALPS index during routine brain MRI
